EmailTemplate.subject: Your resources from "Bouncing Back: Consumer Views on Traveling Again"
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Thank you for attending our Bouncing Back: Consumer Views on Traveling Again webinar. We'll send you the webinar recording as soon as it is available. In the meantime, below are links to several resources you may find useful:
- View the interactive report <[[https://flywire.foleon.com/report/bouncing-back-consumer-views-on-traveling-again/?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> for full results from our survey. - Read the Galangal Travel case study <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/case-study-galangal-travel?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> to learn how clients are saving thousands on payment costs. - Request a free travel payments assessment <[[https://www.flywire.com/industries/travel/payments-assessment?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> to speak to one of our experts about ways to save money and improve your own payment experience.
A special thanks to our panelists for taking part:
- Shannon Stowell, CEO, Adventure Travel Trade Association
- Gonçalo Correia, General Manager, Tours For You
- Jenny Jewczyk, Reservations & Sales Manager, Nimmo Bay Wilderness Resort
Questions? Just reply to this email and we’ll be happy to help.
